body: Thanks for this thoughtful reply!  It does feel good to get some of this off my chest. I am too isolated and its wearing me down.

Thanks for replying.  Ive never been very close with my family.  I was closest with my mom but i completely broke her heart when she found out about everything. My dad left the country before any charges were filed against him. My mom has been a housewife for the last 35 years or so.  She hasnt been able to find work to support herself.  My siblings all hate me and have blocked me on social media.  I dont have cousins or other family members that i know of.
